description.value:
The forbidden technique. Three cosmos ignited as one tear open a hole where the world used to be.

Requirements You are within 30 feet of at least two other creatures who have this feat — Saints, or beings the GM rules can channel cosmo at this tier — and all three of you spend the actions together.

Athena Exclamation ◆◆◆ (three actions, and requires two allies to each spend 3 actions)

Choose a point within 100 feet. Every creature in a 60-foot burst around that point takes @Damage[30d6[force]] damage, with a basic Reflex save against the highest Cosmo DC among the three casters. Creatures that critically fail are also knocked prone and deafened for 1 minute.

The terrain in the area is permanently obliterated — reduced to a crater of fused glass and silence. Structures without saves are destroyed. The landscape does not recover.

Special Using Athena Exclamation is regarded in the Sanctuary as the gravest taboo a Saint can commit: it is the technique that killed gods and drowned continents. Every Saint NPC who learns you have used it will treat you accordingly, and the GM is encouraged to make its use a story event rather than a combat option.

Each participant is drained 2 afterward, recoverable only by a full day's rest under an open sky.
